envelope.description: Add an exclude input to the git_diff tool

body.title: Add an exclude input to the git_diff tool
body.summary: Give git_diff an optional `exclude` list of repo-root globs, declared in its closed input schema and validated in the handler. Each glob is passed to git as a `:(top,exclude,glob)` pathspec on both the body and the numstat command; with no `path` the positive pathspec is `:(top)`, with a `path` it stays as given. Absent or empty `exclude` builds exactly today's arguments.
acceptanceChecks: An excluded file is absent from both the diff body and the file list, and a kept file is present in both
With no `exclude` and with an empty array the body and numstat argument vectors equal today's
`path` plus `exclude` keeps the path as the positive pathspec
A non-array or empty-string `exclude` returns invalid-input without running git, and the input schema declares the field
Each new test was seen to fail with the production change reverted

tests.name: T22 git_diff exclude removes a file from both body and file list
T23 git_diff argument vectors are unchanged without exclude or with an empty array
T24 git_diff keeps path as the positive pathspec alongside exclude
T25 git_diff rejects a malformed exclude and its schema declares the field
